cues.text: With timely messages, both policies schedule successive waves through the four landing pads. The altitude histories show actual descent, contact, and departure. Waiting drones remain at their staging positions. Earlier departures park farther away so they do not block the later arrivals. These preassigned lanes isolate the coordination problem; this is not a general collision-avoidance planner.

观测时效 | guāncè shíxiào | The cost of missing evidence

cues.text: When telemetry also stops, the queue-aware coordinator cannot confirm remote completion. The first wave can finish locally, but the other drones keep waiting. Their flat altitude traces are a real outcome of the hold, not missing animation. This exposes the safety-versus-progress tradeoff. The model has no battery limit, so indefinite hovering is not an operationally safe recovery plan.
